This PR introduces a significant and well-executed refactoring of the dashboard architecture. By moving the client-side logic from `app/page.tsx` into a new `DashboardClient.tsx` component, the main page is successfully converted into a Next.js server component. This improves initial page load performance, reduces the client-side JavaScript bundle, and aligns with modern Next.js best practices for server/client component separation.

The parsing logic in `services/googleDocParser.ts` has been enhanced to correctly handle line breaks and paragraph elements within table cells, which is a valuable fix for data integrity and display consistency. This directly addresses the "fix parsing logic" part of the PR title.

An important accessibility improvement was made in `components/RefreshIconButton.tsx` by explicitly setting the `width` and `height` to 48px. This ensures that the button meets the minimum touch target size as outlined in the `docs/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md`.

Unit tests in `tests/unit/components/DashboardClient.test.tsx` were appropriately updated to reflect the new component structure and now pass `useNativeTable` as a prop, making them more isolated and robust. The cleanup of merge conflict markers in `tests/playwright/lib/waits.ts` is also a good detail.

Overall, this is a high-quality refactor that improves performance, maintainability, and addresses specific issues.
